name: @kilocode/world
description: Browser-automation library backing the kilo world agent tool.

scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts --target bun --outdir dist --entry-naming index.js && bun run build:daemon
scripts.test:ci: bunx playwright install chromium && mkdir -p .artifacts/unit && bun test --timeout 30000 --reporter=junit --reporter-outfile=.artifacts/unit/junit.xml
